race.comment: DIRTY LIL' DIVA (6) resumes second-up after finishing second on the Gold Coast Poly, and that run had more merit than the margin because she was struck trouble at the start and raced wide throughout. The drop to 1010m is the query, yet she brings a good stable-jockey profile for this level. COSMIC SASH (5) was runner-up on debut at Murwillumbah on heavy ground and has upside, although she was beaten as one of the market hopes and tackles 1010m for the first time. PRESTIGE HEADWATER (1) is back from a five-month break after a narrow Grafton second. Trialled solidly at Ballina and the claim helps. FORTUNISTIC (7) is a debutant with a comfortable Ballina trial win and strong local stable behind her. Can make an immediate impact.
